subject.title: feat: add session stream mode command

question: Should OpenClaw accept `SessionEntry.streamingMode` plus a `previewStreamingSessionOverride` channel capability as the permanent cross-channel shape for this command?
rationale: This PR adds a new user-facing command, durable session state, and plugin capability surface; the code defects are mechanical, but the storage/API/channel-scope decision needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept shape after blockers
options.body: Keep this design direction, require the Discord/Slack suppression fixes and live channel proof, then review for merge.

options.title: Narrow the MVP
options.body: Limit the first merge to the channel or channels maintainers are ready to support with live proof, then expand later.

options.title: Defer the command
options.body: Close or pause this implementation until a broader streaming/session control design is agreed.

recommendation.title: Accept shape after blockers
recommendation.body: Keep this design direction, require the Discord/Slack suppression fixes and live channel proof, then review for merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history points to adjacent session-command and shared streaming helper ownership on the exact surfaces that need a product/API decision.
